review_description: We were very happy with the communication, pricing & the punctuality.
Paid a deposit to have a system installed by this businessInstall is in November 2025

Great service from Arctic Energy Toowoomba, very happy with the installation and system. I purchased a 6.6Kw Solar system with an 8Kw Sigenergy Battery, only had the system a month so far but seems to be working very well.I have a 1960s built single level home with an original iron roof that had an older small solar system installed that was no longer working, this system was uninstalled and taken away by Artic at no extra cost.I would have no hesitation in recommending Arctic Energy Toowoomba
Was accommodating with answering the multiple questions I had and was happy to do quotes for different size systems. Very happy with how tidy the install was done.

Arctic Energy were extremely professional from the start. The quote process was so easy and prompt. The installation team were right on time and very polite.  They installed my solar with no fuss and left my property tidy. Customer service was faultless. Once installed,  they took the time to explain everything I needed to know. I couldn't recommend this company more.
Best price, excellent service, quality product.Easy installation process, immediate start of solar power.

The installation of panels were done professionally and on time. Inverter cabling plumbed into wall giving neat appearance. Reasonable pricing quoted on mid-range quality 6.6KW solar system. Works great and better than anticipated. Good communication during proces.s

Installation of a 6.6kw system at our residence is now complete.  The product was purchased through RACQ Solar.  The installation company was Arctic Energy, Toowoomba.  Great team!  Cody of Arctic Energy was polite and easy to talk with about the new system.  The install was completed in only a three hours.  There was no mess left by the team and the final product looks very impressive.  Cody offered information about the workings of the system and the associated monitoring app which now on my phone.  I would recommend both RACG Solar and Arctic Energy to any looking for a home solar solution.

We found Arctic Energy to go out of their way and over and beyond what is required in order to be of assistance. They were reasonable in their quotes and got the job down quickly and efficiently. Would recommend to them anyone thinking of going solar or needing a good electrician

Sales/Quoting - Very Good.  Arise Solar were very aggressive and became somewhat abusive.Installation - Was very easy with no fuss.  Great communication and work was exceptionalCustomer Service was outstanding down to installing the App on my phone and showing me how to use it.The Grid Connection was all organised with 24 hours of installation.

The quoting process was quick and concise. They listened to what we wanted and nothing was an issue for them. The installation was so smooth. The team were very polite and happy at all times. They were punctual and explained any of the questions in detail that we may have had. Arctic Energy arranged everything with our electricity supplier and it made the process very simple for us. We would highly recommend Arctic Energy if anyone was considering to install solar.
Cannot praise enough,  great product, quality, workmanship, they were great guys and would highly recommend.
